prompt.text.description: Task or instructions for the agent to execute.
prompt.text.example: Add a README.md file with installation instructions

source.repository.description: GitHub repository URL for the agent to work in. Required unless using Source PR URL.

source.ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit hash to use as the base ref.

model.description: Explicit model ID from List Models, or `default` to use Cursor's configured default.

target.autoCreatePr.description: Whether Cursor should automatically create a pull request when the agent completes.

target.branchName.description: Custom branch name for the agent to create.

source.prUrl.description: GitHub pull request URL. When provided, Cursor works on the PR repository and branches.

target.openAsCursorGithubApp.description: Open the pull request as the Cursor GitHub App. Only applies when Auto Create PR is true.

target.skipReviewerRequest.description: Skip adding the user as reviewer when PR is opened by the Cursor GitHub App.

target.autoBranch.description: Whether to create a new branch when Source PR URL is provided. Defaults to true.

webhook.url.description: URL to receive agent status-change webhook notifications.

webhook.secret.description: Secret for webhook payload verification, minimum 32 characters.

url.description: Cursor Web URL for the agent.
